# CLI Trail Collaboration Parity — Phase 2 Design

**Date:** 2026-07-10
**Status:** Draft (Phase 2 of 2)
**Depends on:** Phase 1 branch `feat/trail-collaboration-parity` (stacked).

Covers the remaining UI parity gaps: **discussion threads/comments**, **attachments**, and **watchers**. Command naming decided in Phase 1: discussion family = `trail comment`.

## Backend facts (verified against entire.io)

### Threads (number-keyed, under `/api/v1/trails/{forge}/{owner}/{repo}/{number}`)
- `GET .../threads` → `{items: ThreadSummary[], event_cursor}`
- `GET .../threads/{threadId}` → `{thread: ThreadSummary, messages: Message[], event_cursor}`
- `POST .../threads` `{title?, body}` (body required; title defaults "Conversation") → `{thread, message}` (201)
- `PATCH .../threads/{threadId}` `{title?, resolved?}` → `{thread}` (code_review threads: title read-only)
- `POST .../threads/{threadId}/messages` `{body}` → `{message}` (201)
- `PATCH .../threads/{threadId}/messages/{messageId}` `{body}` → `{message}`
- `DELETE .../threads/{threadId}/messages/{messageId}` → `{success: true}`
- Writes require repo membership (server-enforced; CLI surfaces the 403). Body max 65536, title max 512.
- Identity encodings differ: `author`, `last_message_author`, `participants[].login` are GitHub **logins**; `created_by`/`resolved_by` are actor **UUIDs**. `replies` nest one level only.
- Threads have `kind` ∈ `{discussion, code_review}`. `code_review` threads mirror review findings (already surfaced by `trail finding`), so `trail comment list` filters to `discussion` by default.

### Attachments (number-keyed)
- `POST .../attachments?filename={name}&kind=image` — **raw file bytes** body (not multipart), `Content-Type` = image MIME, `Content-Length` required, 10 MB cap, only `image/png`/`image/jpeg`. → `{attachment}` (201).
- `GET .../attachments` → `{attachments: Attachment[]}`
- `DELETE .../attachments/{id}` → **204, empty body** (idempotent)
- No URL field on the object; serve URL is built as `GET /api/v1/trails/{forge}/{owner}/{repo}/attachments/{id}/{variant}` (variant ∈ `thumb|inline|full`; host/owner/repo decorative). Attachment object: `id, trail_id, repo_id, kind, content_type, filename, size_bytes, width?, height?, created_by_user_id?, created_at, deleted_at?`.

### Watchers (trail-UUID-keyed, under `/api/v1`)
- `GET /api/v1/trails/{trail_id}/watchers` → `{watchers: string[]}` — **user UUIDs** (not logins), sorted; presence-based (currently-connected SSE viewers). 503 `{error}` if trail-watch not configured. Read-only. Uses the trail's `id` (UUID), not its number.

## Design

### New wire structs — `cmd/entire/cli/api/`
- `trail_thread_types.go`: `TrailThreadReply`, `TrailThreadMessage`, `TrailThreadParticipant`, `TrailThreadSummary` (omit the `review_comment` blob — code-review threads are handled by findings; decoding can ignore it), `TrailThreadsResponse`, `TrailThreadDetailResponse`, `TrailThreadCreateRequest{Title omitempty, Body}`, `TrailThreadCreateResponse{Thread, Message *…}`, `TrailThreadUpdateRequest{Title *string, Resolved *bool}`, `TrailThreadUpdateResponse{Thread}`, `TrailThreadMessageRequest{Body}`, `TrailThreadMessageResponse{Message}`.
- `trail_attachment_types.go`: `TrailAttachment` (all fields, pointers for nullable `Width/Height/CreatedByUserID/DeletedAt`), `TrailAttachmentsResponse{Attachments}`, `TrailAttachmentUploadResponse{Attachment}`.
- `TrailWatchersResponse{Watchers []string}` (in a small `trail_watcher_types.go`).

### `trail comment` subtree — `cmd/entire/cli/trail_comment_cmd.go`
Reuses `resolveNumberedTrail` (generalized in Phase 1) and `trailNumberPath`. Path helpers: `trailThreadsPath`, `trailThreadPath`, `trailThreadMessagesPath`, `trailThreadMessagePath`.
- `comment list [<trail>] [--branch] [--json] [--all]` — list threads (discussion only unless `--all`; `--json` dumps raw). Human view: id, resolved marker, title, message_count, last activity.
- `comment show <thread-id> [<trail>] [--branch] [--json]` — thread + messages (author login, timestamp, body; replies indented).
- `comment add [<trail>] [--title] -m/--body <text> [--branch]` — create thread (body required).
- `comment reply <thread-id> -m/--body <text> [<trail>] [--branch]` — add message.
- `comment edit <thread-id> <message-id> -m/--body <text> [<trail>] [--branch]` — edit message.
- `comment delete <thread-id> <message-id> [<trail>] [--branch] [-f/--force]` — delete message (TTY-or-`--force` guard, mirroring `confirmTrailDeletion`).
- `comment resolve <thread-id>` / `comment unresolve <thread-id>` `[<trail>] [--branch]` — PATCH `{resolved}`.

### `trail attachment` subtree — `cmd/entire/cli/trail_attachment_cmd.go`
- `attachment list [<trail>] [--branch] [--json]` — id, filename, content_type, size, created_at.
- `attachment add <file> [<trail>] [--branch] [--json]` — read file, detect MIME (only png/jpeg; reject others client-side with a clear message), `client.Request(POST, path?filename=&kind=image, headers{Content-Type}, bytes.Reader)`. Prints id + a serve URL (built from id + `inline`).
- `attachment remove <id> [<trail>] [--branch] [-f/--force]` — DELETE; treats 204 as success.

### `trail watchers` — `cmd/entire/cli/trail_watchers_cmd.go`
- `watchers [<trail>] [--branch] [--json]` — resolve the trail, GET `/api/v1/trails/{id}/watchers` by UUID, print the user-id list (help text notes they are live-viewer user IDs, and a 503 means trail-watch isn't configured for the deployment).

### Registration
`newTrailCmd` adds `newTrailCommentCmd()`, `newTrailAttachmentCmd()`, `newTrailWatchersCmd()`.

## Testing
- Path builders (threads/messages/attachments) suffix checks.
- Thread decode: a summary + message JSON fixture decodes with correct login vs actor-id fields and nested single-level replies.
- `TrailThreadCreateRequest`/`TrailThreadUpdateRequest` marshal: body required; resolved pointer distinguishes set-false from omit.
- Attachment MIME detection helper: png/jpeg accepted, others rejected.
- Attachment decode: nullable fields (`width`/`deleted_at`) tolerate null.
- Delete-message confirm gate (TTY vs `--force`), mirroring the existing `confirmTrailDeletion` test.
- Command wiring: each subtree registers its subcommands and expected flags.
- `--json` fallbacks present on list/show/watchers (agent-safe, non-interactive).

## Out of scope
Collaborative body editor (WebSocket presence), SSE `trail watch` (already exists), repo-wide watchers.

## Key files
- `cmd/entire/cli/api/trail_thread_types.go`, `trail_attachment_types.go`, `trail_watcher_types.go` (new)
- `cmd/entire/cli/trail_comment_cmd.go`, `trail_attachment_cmd.go`, `trail_watchers_cmd.go` (new)
- `cmd/entire/cli/trail_cmd.go` (register three subtrees)
- `*_test.go` alongside each

# CLI Trail Collaboration Parity — Phase 2 Design

**Date:** 2026-07-10
**Status:** Draft (Phase 2 of 2)
**Depends on:** Phase 1 branch `feat/trail-collaboration-parity` (stacked).

Covers the remaining UI parity gaps: **discussion threads/comments**, **attachments**, and **watchers**. Command naming decided in Phase 1: discussion family = `trail comment`.

## Backend facts (verified against entire.io)

### Threads (number-keyed, under `/api/v1/trails/{forge}/{owner}/{repo}/{number}`)
- `GET .../threads` → `{items: ThreadSummary[], event_cursor}`
- `GET .../threads/{threadId}` → `{thread: ThreadSummary, messages: Message[], event_cursor}`
- `POST .../threads` `{title?, body}` (body required; title defaults "Conversation") → `{thread, message}` (201)
- `PATCH .../threads/{threadId}` `{title?, resolved?}` → `{thread}` (code_review threads: title read-only)
- `POST .../threads/{threadId}/messages` `{body}` → `{message}` (201)
- `PATCH .../threads/{threadId}/messages/{messageId}` `{body}` → `{message}`
- `DELETE .../threads/{threadId}/messages/{messageId}` → `{success: true}`
- Writes require repo membership (server-enforced; CLI surfaces the 403). Body max 65536, title max 512.
- Identity encodings differ: `author`, `last_message_author`, `participants[].login` are GitHub **logins**; `created_by`/`resolved_by` are actor **UUIDs**. `replies` nest one level only.
- Threads have `kind` ∈ `{discussion, code_review}`. `code_review` threads mirror review findings (already surfaced by `trail finding`), so `trail comment list` filters to `discussion` by default.

### Attachments (number-keyed)
- `POST .../attachments?filename={name}&kind=image` — **raw file bytes** body (not multipart), `Content-Type` = image MIME, `Content-Length` required, 10 MB cap, only `image/png`/`image/jpeg`. → `{attachment}` (201).
- `GET .../attachments` → `{attachments: Attachment[]}`
- `DELETE .../attachments/{id}` → **204, empty body** (idempotent)
- No URL field on the object; serve URL is built as `GET /api/v1/trails/{forge}/{owner}/{repo}/attachments/{id}/{variant}` (variant ∈ `thumb|inline|full`; host/owner/repo decorative). Attachment object: `id, trail_id, repo_id, kind, content_type, filename, size_bytes, width?, height?, created_by_user_id?, created_at, deleted_at?`.

### Watchers (trail-UUID-keyed, under `/api/v1`)
- `GET /api/v1/trails/{trail_id}/watchers` → `{watchers: string[]}` — **user UUIDs** (not logins), sorted; presence-based (currently-connected SSE viewers). 503 `{error}` if trail-watch not configured. Read-only. Uses the trail's `id` (UUID), not its number.

## Design

### New wire structs — `cmd/entire/cli/api/`
- `trail_thread_types.go`: `TrailThreadReply`, `TrailThreadMessage`, `TrailThreadParticipant`, `TrailThreadSummary` (omit the `review_comment` blob — code-review threads are handled by findings; decoding can ignore it), `TrailThreadsResponse`, `TrailThreadDetailResponse`, `TrailThreadCreateRequest{Title omitempty, Body}`, `TrailThreadCreateResponse{Thread, Message *…}`, `TrailThreadUpdateRequest{Title *string, Resolved *bool}`, `TrailThreadUpdateResponse{Thread}`, `TrailThreadMessageRequest{Body}`, `TrailThreadMessageResponse{Message}`.
- `trail_attachment_types.go`: `TrailAttachment` (all fields, pointers for nullable `Width/Height/CreatedByUserID/DeletedAt`), `TrailAttachmentsResponse{Attachments}`, `TrailAttachmentUploadResponse{Attachment}`.
- `TrailWatchersResponse{Watchers []string}` (in a small `trail_watcher_types.go`).

### `trail comment` subtree — `cmd/entire/cli/trail_comment_cmd.go`
Reuses `resolveNumberedTrail` (generalized in Phase 1) and `trailNumberPath`. Path helpers: `trailThreadsPath`, `trailThreadPath`, `trailThreadMessagesPath`, `trailThreadMessagePath`.
- `comment list [<trail>] [--branch] [--json] [--all]` — list threads (discussion only unless `--all`; `--json` dumps raw). Human view: id, resolved marker, title, message_count, last activity.
- `comment show <thread-id> [<trail>] [--branch] [--json]` — thread + messages (author login, timestamp, body; replies indented).
- `comment add [<trail>] [--title] -m/--body <text> [--branch]` — create thread (body required).
- `comment reply <thread-id> -m/--body <text> [<trail>] [--branch]` — add message.
- `comment edit <thread-id> <message-id> -m/--body <text> [<trail>] [--branch]` — edit message.
- `comment delete <thread-id> <message-id> [<trail>] [--branch] [-f/--force]` — delete message (TTY-or-`--force` guard, mirroring `confirmTrailDeletion`).
- `comment resolve <thread-id>` / `comment unresolve <thread-id>` `[<trail>] [--branch]` — PATCH `{resolved}`.

### `trail attachment` subtree — `cmd/entire/cli/trail_attachment_cmd.go`
- `attachment list [<trail>] [--branch] [--json]` — id, filename, content_type, size, created_at.
- `attachment add <file> [<trail>] [--branch] [--json]` — read file, detect MIME (only png/jpeg; reject others client-side with a clear message), `client.Request(POST, path?filename=&kind=image, headers{Content-Type}, bytes.Reader)`. Prints id + a serve URL (built from id + `inline`).
- `attachment remove <id> [<trail>] [--branch] [-f/--force]` — DELETE; treats 204 as success.

### `trail watchers` — `cmd/entire/cli/trail_watchers_cmd.go`
- `watchers [<trail>] [--branch] [--json]` — resolve the trail, GET `/api/v1/trails/{id}/watchers` by UUID, print the user-id list (help text notes they are live-viewer user IDs, and a 503 means trail-watch isn't configured for the deployment).

### Registration
`newTrailCmd` adds `newTrailCommentCmd()`, `newTrailAttachmentCmd()`, `newTrailWatchersCmd()`.

## Testing
- Path builders (threads/messages/attachments) suffix checks.
- Thread decode: a summary + message JSON fixture decodes with correct login vs actor-id fields and nested single-level replies.
- `TrailThreadCreateRequest`/`TrailThreadUpdateRequest` marshal: body required; resolved pointer distinguishes set-false from omit.
- Attachment MIME detection helper: png/jpeg accepted, others rejected.
- Attachment decode: nullable fields (`width`/`deleted_at`) tolerate null.
- Delete-message confirm gate (TTY vs `--force`), mirroring the existing `confirmTrailDeletion` test.
- Command wiring: each subtree registers its subcommands and expected flags.
- `--json` fallbacks present on list/show/watchers (agent-safe, non-interactive).

## Out of scope
Collaborative body editor (WebSocket presence), SSE `trail watch` (already exists), repo-wide watchers.

## Key files
- `cmd/entire/cli/api/trail_thread_types.go`, `trail_attachment_types.go`, `trail_watcher_types.go` (new)
- `cmd/entire/cli/trail_comment_cmd.go`, `trail_attachment_cmd.go`, `trail_watchers_cmd.go` (new)
- `cmd/entire/cli/trail_cmd.go` (register three subtrees)
- `*_test.go` alongside each
